Concomitant medication(s) included: XARELTO taken for coagulopathy (ongoing). The patient also took other concomitant therapy. Vaccination history included: Moderna covid vaccines, administration date: Feb2021, for Immunization; Moderna covid vaccines, administration date: Mar2021, for Immunization; Flucelvax (In Sept or Oct and would have Flucelvax. it wasn't high dose. ,  Lot Number/ Expiry Date: unknown ,  Route, Anatomical Location: intramuscularly, left upper arm. She always gets everything on left side.), for Immunization. The following information was reported: PLEURISY (disability) with onset 06Jan2024, outcome "recovering". The event "pleurisy" required physician office visit and emergency room visit. The patient underwent the following laboratory tests and procedures: Blood test: Normal, notes: everything is normal; Computerised tomogram: Normal, notes: everything is normal; Electrocardiogram: Normal, notes: everything is normal; Antibodies: Negative; SARS-CoV-2 test: Negative, notes: got tested for Covid 3 to 4 times during the pandemic and was always negative; Ultrasound scan: she had DVT. Therapeutic measures were taken as a result of pleurisy. The caller asks if there is any information regarding Pfizer Biontech COVID-19 vaccine, that she got back in 2021, and pleurisy. The caller states she developed pleurisy on Saturday and wants to check every box on why she got it. Pleurisy was reported as disabling/incapacitating. Caller states she is a pharmacist and also a patient. Caller received two Moderna Covid Vaccines, one in Feb2021 and one in Mar2021. Caller has called them. On 01Dec2021 caller received the Pfizer Covid vaccine. Those are the only 3 Covid vaccines she has received. Two days ago caller developed pleurisy. Went to Emergency Room. She had bad chest pain and thought it was a heart attack. They tested heart and for pulmonary embolism. She had CT, EKG, and blood work and everything is normal. Caller doesn't know how she developed pleurisy or why she got it. She has looked up that pleurisy is due to bacterial infection, or viral infection, or being on Methotrexate, or having sickle cell, but caller doesn't have any of those things. Caller's friends said maybe it was due to the vaccine. It is has been 2 years, but maybe long haul. As far as caller knows she hasn't had Covid infection at all. Caller thought maybe she had Covid when Covid first came out in 2020. In Mar2020 everyone was notified about Covid, but it was in Jan2020 when caller got really sick. Caller got tested for Covid 3 to 4 times during the pandemic and was always negative. Caller clarified that she is calling to ask if pleurisy has been documented with the Pfizer Covid vaccine. Treatment:  At the Emergency Room right before leaving they gave her IV Dexamethasone to relieve inflammation and wheezing pain. She was given a prescription to get filled of Prednisone 20mg once a day for 4 days. Today is second day of taking Prednisone. Concomitant Medications: takes Xarelto. Caller has a blood clotting disorder and thought this was related to a Pulmonary Embolism. Caller had a Pulmonary Embolism 13 months ago. Caller doesn't have Pulmonary Embolism now because she is on Xarelto. Caller has blood clotting disorder that was diagnosed on 06Dec2022. She had Chest X-ray, EKG, CT scan, and blood work. She has no new Pulmonary Embolism and had no heart attack. The CT scan showed pleurisy which is inflammation of lining of lungs and that was causing chest pain. Prior Vaccinations (within 4 weeks):  In Sept or Oct and would have Flucelvax. it wasn't high dose.  She would not have been on medication when she got Pfizer Covid Vaccine. Started Xarelto 13 months ago.  Specific Relevant Test: For Thromboembolic events with Thrombocytopenia: She got PRP in left ankle because she had tendonitis. Had two doses of PRP.
